question: For each port status, list the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and the variance of the standard attribute ID (using the same filtering rules as before: only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', excluding shared networks, and restricting to port statuses that also have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8). Do not repeat the port status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per port status across all device owners. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.status AS port_status,
         p.device_owner,
         p.id AS port_id,
         p.standard_attr_id,
         sa.updated_at
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND NOT p.network_id IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id
      FROM networkrbacs nr
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
    AND p.status IN (
      SELECT p2.status
      FROM ports p2
      JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p2.id
      WHERE ia.ip_address = '10.150.64.113/8'
    )
),
detail AS (
  SELECT port_status,
         device_owner,
         COUNT(port_id) AS port_count,
         MIN(updated_at) AS earliest_standard_attr_update,
         VARIANCE(standard_attr_id) AS standard_attr_id_variance
  FROM base
  GROUP BY port_status, device_owner
),
subtotal AS (
  SELECT port_status,
         'SUBTOTAL' AS device_owner,
         COUNT(port_id) AS port_count,
         MIN(updated_at) AS earliest_standard_attr_update,
         VARIANCE(standard_attr_id) AS standard_attr_id_variance
  FROM base
  GROUP BY port_status
)
SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, standard_attr_id_variance
FROM detail
UNION ALL
SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, standard_attr_id_variance
FROM subtotal
ORDER BY port_status, (device_owner = 'SUBTOTAL'), device_owner
